name: Retreats
overview: Scripture reveals that retreats are essential moments of rest and renewal provided by God for His people. Jesus invites the weary to come to Him for rest, emphasizing the importance of withdrawing from busyness to find restoration, as seen when He encouraged His disciples to rest in a quiet place. The psalmist and the prophet Jeremiah affirm that God satisfies the soul and replenishes the sorrowful, while Psalms and Proverbs remind believers to trust in the Lord’s guidance and remain attentive to His commands during these times of stillness.
